scientific_integrity: The Pluecker relation and alternating-form rank normal forms are classical and are not independently asserted as novel. Finite experimental checks do not constitute the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields; exterior algebra on four generators; ordered-pair ordinary commutator fibers; proof covers all odd prime powers, exhaustive computer validation only q=3 (odd pairs), q=3 and q=5 (vector wedges). Potential uninspected broader equivalences remain. No claim of first publication priority.
title: The Pluecker-cone commutator fibers of the four-generator exterior algebra
